module.purpose: Implements shared Fragment Ref comparison logic used by both DOM and Fabric React renderer configs to compute a node's document-position relationship relative to an empty fragment (a fragment Fiber that rendered no children). It derives position from the fragment's parent host instance and its next rendered sibling, returning a bitwise mask of Node.DOCUMENT_POSITION_* constants so ref attachment and aria/sibling ordering resolve identically across configs.
module.summary: A single exported Flow-typed utility in the React reconciler shared layer computes the DOM document position of an arbitrary otherNode relative to an empty fragment fiber. It first queries the parent host instance via compareDocumentPosition; if that reports the otherNode is contained as a sibling, it consults the reconciler's tree-reflection helper to fetch the next sibling fiber, maps it back to a public instance through an injected getPublicInstance callback, and queries its position to decide whether the otherNode follows or precedes the fragment. Every returned mask is OR-ed with DOCUMENT_POSITION_IMPLEMENTATION_SPECIFIC. The helper holds no module state, relies on a global Node bitmask, and is consumed by renderer configs to order refs and owner/nesting queries around childless fragments.
module.businessContext: DOM and Fabric React renderer configs share this helper to order fragment refs and sibling/owner relationships around childless fragments. A defect here misorders empty-fragment refs, breaking ref callbacks, focus management, and aria-owns resolution.
